newsitem.title: UK: Bellway boosts housebuilders after results.
newsitem.headline: Bellway boosts housebuilders after results.

text.p: Shares in housebuilder Bellway Plc led UK housebuilding stocks higher after strong first-half results, analysts said.
The shares jumped 15p to 355p by 0835 GMT, after Bellway's first half pre-tax profits came in at 17.9 million stg against 12.3 million stg a year before.
"The pre-tax number was boosted by Bellway's disposal of a holding in Wainhomes but the underlying profit margins are good," said Robin Hardy, building and construction analyst at Panmure Gordon.
Hardy said he may upgrade his full-year forecast following the analysts meeting today.
The rest of the housebuilding sector took heart from Bellway's results, with Beazer Group up 10p to 179p ahead of an expected analyst visit to the company on Thursday.
Barratt Developments climbed 8p to 261p, Bryant Group rose 2p to 126p and Wainhomes gained 3p to 148p.

Hardy said Tuesday's UK housing starts data, a rise of one per cent seasonally adjusted in the three months to March, had given impetus to the sector despite Tuesday's quarter-point rise in UK base rates.
